fact: The Togolese government portal says the July 2026 project to build AI models for 50 national languages, with Togo AI Lab, Zindi and Umbaji, falls within Togo's national AI strategy, treating it as an existing framework; no adopting act or date is named.
Tic Infos reports Togo's digital-economy ministry launched a call for AI experts to take part in drafting a national AI strategy, with registrations open to 18 October.
